name: 1 Apr 1956

references.label: Ministry of Health and Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation (Bangor Borough Extension) Act (Northern Ireland) 1956
references.note: Local Act confirming the Bangor Borough (Extension) Order (Northern Ireland) 1955. Royal Assent 1 May 1956 (Belfast Gazette issue 1819, 4 May 1956, page 121). Appointed day 1 Apr 1956, before Royal Assent: the Order took effect from that day, as with the Coleraine Order of 1962. No appointing notice appears in the Belfast Gazette between issues 1780 and 1822 (Jul 1955 to May 1956), and Civgraph's OSNI administrative-areas series dates this change 1 Apr 1956. The Census of Population 1961, General Report (HMSO Belfast), pp. xvi-xvii, changes in administrative areas during the intercensal period, https://www.nisra.gov.uk/publications/1961-census-reports, records the transfer from the rural district to the borough on 1 Apr 1956.
